items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 75:1
items.html: (To the question) What is Knesset Israel and Malchut? The external body of the Nukva, namely the aspect of the VAK within her, is called the Partzuf of Malchut. And the Partzuf of the Mochin of the Nukva, namely her inner Partzuf, is called Knesset Israel, because she is attributed as the aspect of the Nukva to the Partzuf of the Mochin of ZA, called Israel. And therefore she is called Knesset Israel. (Item 178).
